characters.summary: Phoenix Five Namor is infused with one-fifth of the cosmic Phoenix Force, granting him god-like reality manipulation, cosmic fire, and planetary-scale tidal control.

techniques: Tidal wave summoning on a continental scale

mechanisms: Regeneration from almost any physical harm

weaknesses: Vulnerability to mental corruption and chaotic instability inherent to the Phoenix Force
limitations: Power can be fractured or absorbed by other cosmic entities or telepathic intervention
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard mutant physiology with a fragment of the cosmic Phoenix Force, exponentially increasing power and adding cosmic energy projection.

feats.claim: Flooded Wakanda with a massive tidal wave

notableResults.note: Overwhelmed Wakanda's defenses with a massive flood before being subdued by combined forces.

conditional.ability: Planetary tidal manipulation and cosmic pyrokinesis
conditional.dependsOn: Possession of the Phoenix Force fragment

campaignTags.claim: Flight powered by the Phoenix Force
Command over massive oceanic bodies and mega-tsunamis

unknowns: Exact mechanics of how the Phoenix fragment interacts with his native mutant abilities.

characters.summary: Nebula is a cybernetic assassin and warrior who utilizes advanced alien weaponry, hand-to-hand combat mastery, and a high pain tolerance. She overcomes heavy damage through extensive cybernetic reconstruction.
weaknesses: Internal cybernetic components can be hacked or disrupted by specialized tech
limitations: Battery or power dependencies for certain heavy cybernetic enhancements

sources.supports: MCU history, cybernetics, and combat skills

feats.claim: Fought Gamora to a standstill in hand-to-hand combat

notableResults.note: Defeated after a prolonged duel due to Gamora's superior leverage and emotional edge

campaignTags.claim: Extensive cybernetic body modifications and mechanical replacement parts
Uses energy batons, explosive charges, and integrated blasters
Pilots various spacecraft including Milano-class ships

unknowns: Full extent of her self-repair capabilities without external tools.

characters.summary: Ned Leeds is a civilian tech assistant who unexpectedly unlocks magical portal creation using Doctor Strange's sling ring. He fights primarily through defensive evasion and improvised spellcasting.
weaknesses: Lack of formal combat training or physical durability
Relies entirely on external magical artifacts
limitations: Inability to control portals reliably without intense focus and visualization

sources.supports: Role as Peter Parker's friend and accidental sling ring user in Spider-Man: No Way Home

feats.claim: Successfully opened a portal to find alternate universe variants of Peter Parker

conditional.dependsOn: Holding and focusing with the sling ring

campaignTags.claim: Uses a sling ring to open interdimensional portals
Capable of opening gateways across vast distances and between universes
Casts spells via mystic artifacts without formal training
Wields the sling ring as a magical focus

unknowns: Whether he retains any affinity for magic beyond using the sling ring.

limitations: Lacks finesse or complex tactical reasoning beyond direct commands

characters.summary: Young Odin during the stone age of Earth, acting as a brutal, bloodthirsty warrior wielding Mjolnir before passing it to Thor, relying heavily on raw physical might and primal magic.
weaknesses: Reckless temper and lack of the wisdom possessed in his later years
limitations: Prone to emotional outbursts and tactical overconfidence
characters.formDifferences: Represents Odin in his aggressive youth before acquiring the Odinforce in full maturity, utilizing Mjolnir directly instead of Gungnir.

Flight by throwing and holding onto Mjolnir
